faqSubtitle: Clear, transparent answers to questions you may have before getting started:
faq1Q: I am a complete beginner and never traded before. Can I learn?
faq1A: Yes, absolutely. Every lesson is crafted from ground zero. You will first understand candlestick foundations, then advance systematically into institutional Price Action and Smart Money Concepts (SMC).
faq2Q: Do I need an expensive laptop, or can I learn on my mobile phone?
faq2A: You can watch all masterclass lessons and participate in the community on your smartphone. However, for charting on TradingView, having a basic laptop or desktop screen is recommended.
faq3Q: How much capital do I need to start trading after completing the course?
faq3A: We strongly advise against depositing real money right away. First master your setups on a demo account. Once consistent, you can start with small capital or qualify for funded accounts via Prop Firms.
faq4Q: How is the course delivered after payment?
faq4A: After submitting your form, our team contacts you via WhatsApp. As soon as your payment is verified (bKash/Nagad/Bank), you receive instant access to the private VIP group and video lessons.
faq5Q: Does Asik Rana guarantee 100% daily profit?
faq5A: No, absolutely not. Anyone promising 100% guaranteed daily profits is running a scam. Trading involves real market risk. We teach mathematical risk management, high-probability setups, and emotional discipline so you can stay consistently profitable over the long term.
